about: Generated by conformance/family_oracle (make family-vectors). Do not edit by hand.
Every derived value comes from the independent Python oracle, never from Rust.
Rust tests read the inputs, recompute the outputs, and compare.
The cases are the registered vectors of quip/twisted-ice-dimer revision 1, generated by twisted.py.
The recipes section holds the three live z(12, 4) parameter sets with two salts each. It stores hashes and counts, not instances.
The obstructions section holds inputs and outputs of the gauge obstruction diagnostic, which describes an instance and never decides acceptance.
The admission section holds requests with their expected admission codes.
